data.reasoning: Both models agree the PKGBUILD is a standard, safe binary package that downloads a prebuilt artifact from GitHub with pinned SHA-256 checksums. The disagreement is solely due to the Qwen model experiencing truncated/malformed responses for non-executable metadata files (.SRCINFO, LICENSE), which does not affect the security posture of the package.
data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is an artifact of a tool/model error (truncated response) in the Qwen model for .SRCINFO and LICENSE files, resulting in an 'inconclusive' verdict. The Deepseek model successfully reviewed all files and correctly identified the package as safe.
coverage_issues: Qwen model failed to complete its review of .SRCINFO and LICENSE due to truncated/malformed responses.
learnings: Implement graceful degradation for truncated or malformed model responses on non-critical files (like LICENSE or .SRCINFO) so they don't force an overall 'inconclusive' verdict when the critical PKGBUILD is successfully audited.
Investigate why the file list contains duplicate 'LICENSE' entries and ensure unique file paths are presented to the model.
